# Synapse 2.0.17

Moving a workflow from OpenAI Agent Builder: Synapse AI now asks for the workflow's Agents SDK code, from an export or a copy you saved, or for a description in your own words, so its directions stay true once Agent Builder has closed.

## Fixed

- **Moving a workflow from OpenAI Agent Builder no longer depends on Agent Builder being open.** Sent with nothing pasted under it, the "Move a workflow from OpenAI Agent Builder" line told you to open the workflow in Agent Builder and export it, which can't be done once Agent Builder has closed. Synapse AI now asks for the workflow's Agents SDK code, whether an export from Agent Builder or a copy you saved, or for a description of the workflow in your own words, and plans it from either.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.17`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.

**Full changelog:** [v2.0.16...v2.0.17](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/compare/v2.0.16...v2.0.17) · [Documentation](https://docs.synapseorch.com)
